Materials used in the machine can degrade over time, simple factors like –outside temperature can fluctuate, and high usage and low usage play a roll. This is an essential part of work for our process and equipment experts.As a PhD candidate, you will be looking differently at our machines and processes. You already have a scientist´s or an engineer´s view. You know and see the parameters available, regardless of current usage. Latest advances in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence indicate the possibility for improvements and will guide your research.The goal of this work shall be the summary and testing of state-of-the-art methods in real-world applications as well as development of new methods tailored to the needs of the semiconductor industry, so in this work Data Science approaches are to be developed to enable process experts to use ML and AI for machine and process tuning.   The contract for this position is set up for 3 years with the possibility to extend it by one additional year, if required. jobs.description: What you can expect About Honext x WEPA Honext x WEPA GmbH is a new joint venture between two family businesses: Honext Material (Barcelona), a pioneer in circular building materials, and the WEPA Group (Arnsberg), one of Europe's leading hygiene paper producers with more than 4,500 employees at 15 sites.Together we are building a new production plant in Kriebstein, Saxony , right next to WEPA's paper mill. There we turn fibres recovered from waste paper recycling into HONEXT® fibreboards : resin-free, lightweight, fire-retardant, acoustically strong and fully recyclable at end of life. The boards are Cradle to Cradle Certified® Gold and used in interior design, wall and ceiling cladding, acoustic panels and furniture.The project is backed by the European Investment Bank. Now we need the person who turns it into a running plant. Your mission You build it. As Head of Production you are one of the first leaders in a start-up with the backing of two established industrial partners. You lead the plant from project phase to steady operation: you drive the build-up, coordinate everyone involved, make the calls and grow the team that will run Europe's next circular fibreboard plant.This is not a role for administering what exists. It is for someone who wants to own the result, think like an entrepreneur and see their decisions turn into a working factory. What you'll do• Lead people: Hire, lead and develop the production team from day one. You set the tone for a culture of ownership, collaboration and high performance.• Drive the build-up: Push the plant project forward with drive and pace, from ramp-up to stable series production, and turn plans into results.• Coordinate the project: Act as the central link between project management, engineering, technology suppliers, authorities and both shareholders, Honext and WEPA.• Make decisions: Take responsibility for critical decisions on safety, environment, quality and operations, and stand behind them.• Build structures: Set up lean processes, standards and KPIs that make the plant efficient and competitive from the start.• Own the numbers: Take responsibility for production budget, costs and performance, and improve them continuously.• Represent the plant: Negotiate and communicate confidently in English with international partners, suppliers and the team in Barcelona.What we expect from you Must-haves• Several years of leadership experience in production, ideally as plant or production manager, with a track record of leading and developing teams.• Experience in driving projects and coordinating many stakeholders at once.• Business fluent English, confident enough to negotiate.• A degree in engineering (e.g. mechanical, process or production engineering, industrial engineering) or a comparable qualification.Big pluses• Experience in the paper industry, or in related fields such as pulp, board, wood-based panels or furniture.• Start-up experience or experience building up a plant, line or organisation from scratch.Who you are• You want to build something and you identify with what you build: circular production, made in Saxony.• You are driven, hands-on and want to carry responsibility.• You think like an entrepreneur: you weigh costs, risks and opportunities and decide.• You lead with clarity and stay calm and solution-oriented when things move fast.What we offer you• Real impact: Shape structures, processes and the team of a new plant from the very beginning.• Start-up spirit with industrial backing: Short decision paths and high autonomy, combined with the expertise and resources of Honext and WEPA.• A product with purpose: Help scale a circular material that turns paper industry residues into high-quality boards.• Growth: A role that grows with the company, with room for professional and personal development.• International setting: Close collaboration with teams in Germany and Spain.Ready to build it with us? We look forward to your application.About usWe are PeopleX. We bring together people who fit professionally and culturally.We are an in-house as well as external HR consultancy specializing in supporting small and medium-sized enterprises. Our goal is to find, develop, and retain employees who fit both professionally and culturally, to shape a successful and sustainable future collaboratively.

Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!In der Fakultät für Naturwissenschaften – AG Bartley, Department Physik, Institut für Photonische Quantensysteme – ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Stelle alswissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiterin (w/m/d)**(Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L)im Umfang von 100 % der regelmäßigen Arbeitszeit zu besetzen. Veröffentlichungen, Vorträge und Patentanmeldungen, sowie ggfs. Nachfolgeprojekten und -aktivitätenEinstellungsvoraussetzungen:• Ein überdurchschnittlicher abgeschlossener wissenschaftlicher Hochschulabschluss (Master) sowie eine sehr gut abgeschlossene Promotion sind vorausgesetzt.• Exzellente englisch Kenntnisse in Schrift und Sprache werden erwartet.• Erfahrungen im Bereich der Charakterisierung und dem Design von SNSPDs und den dazugehörigen Kavitäten sind erwünscht.• Kenntnisse über den Aufbau und die Funktionsweise von Josephson Junction basierten Schaltkreisen sind vom Vorteil.• Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Kenntnisse in Cadence, oder vergleichbaren SPICE Simulatoren.• Erfahrungen im Bereich der Charakterisierung von supraleitenden Schaltkreisen sind vom Vorteil.• Vom Vorteil sind Wissen über die Anforderung von photonischen Quantensystemen an Detektorsystemen.• Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Kenntnisse in der Sicherung von Patenten.Wir bieten Ihnen:• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung sowie die individuelle Möglichkeit zur mobilen Arbeit• Vielzahl von Gesundheits-, Beratungs- und Präventionsangeboten• Attraktive Nebenleistungen wie Kinderbetreuungsmöglichkeiten und Sportangebote• Möglichkeit zur internen und externen Fort- und Weiterbildung• Zusätzliche Leistungen nach dem Tarifvertrag der Länder (TV-L) wie Jahressonderzahlung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie die Zusatzversorgung der VBLBewerbungen von Frauen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht und werden gem.
